name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
summary: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, patrons hunger for Ragnar Thunderbrew's famed ribs. His regular supplier has joined the King's Army, so Ragnar needs fresh crag boar ribs and Rhapsody Malt to keep them on the menu.

sections.title: A Tavern in Need
sections.body: Tavern keeper Ragnar Thunderbrew has eager customers, but his pantry is bare. The local hunter who supplied fresh meat enlisted in the King's Army to reinforce the Alliance front. Now Ragnar has no fresh ribs for the patrons who favor them.

sections.title: The Secret Ingredient
sections.body: Crag boars roam the snowy foothills around Kharanos, and their meat is tough. Ragnar's recipe also calls for fresh Rhapsody Malt, drawn straight from the distillery's taps. The malt softens the game meat and makes a savory feast fit for a dwarf's praise.

faq.q: Why is Ragnar Thunderbrew short on meat?
aliases: what happened to ragnar meat supplier
faq.answer: Ragnar's regular meat supplier was a local mountain trapper who left Kharanos to enlist in the King's Army. The trapper went to support Alliance operations abroad, leaving the tavern without a steady supply of game.

faq.q: Where does Rhapsody Malt come from?
aliases: how to get malt for ragnar
faq.answer: Rhapsody Malt is brewed and served at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Ragnar draws it straight from the tavern bar.

faq.q: What kind of boars provide the ribs?
aliases: where find boar ribs dun morogh
faq.answer: Crag boars roaming the hills, snowdrifts, and frozen valleys around Kharanos in Dun Morogh provide the ribs.

faq.q: What is the secret to Ragnar's rib recipe?
faq.answer: Ragnar bastes tough boar ribs in Rhapsody Malt. The malt tenderizes the cold-weather game and gives it the rich flavor of dwarven brewing.

faq.q: Who is fighting on the front lines for the King's Army?
aliases: what war is the kings army fighting
faq.answer: Dwarven recruits join the King's Army in its ongoing conflicts against troggs, dark iron incursions, and other military fronts across the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderbrew Distillery located?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew Distillery is Kharanos's primary tavern and inn, along the main road through central Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As someone who enjoys cooking over a hearth, you can learn to blend malt liquor with wild game from one of Dun Morogh's famed brewmasters.
As a dwarf, you know hearty ale and roasted boar are at the heart of mountain hospitality. Keeping the distillery stocked is a matter of local pride.
As an Alliance member, you can see the war effort reach even Kharanos's taverns. Local mountain folk leave their trades to answer the call to arms.
